seo.home_title: Fruta da Rua: Lisbon's fruit trees, in season
seo.home_description: A map of the fruit trees on Lisbon's streets and gardens. See what's ripe near you right now, from loquats to pomegranates, and how to pick respectfully.

seo.calendar_title: Lisbon fruit calendar: what to pick each month | Fruta da Rua
seo.calendar_description: When each fruit on Lisbon's trees ripens: loquats, figs, mulberries, pomegranates, persimmons, oranges and more. A month by month calendar.
map.label: Map of Lisbon's fruit trees. Use the fruit list to navigate with the keyboard.
calendar.title: Lisbon fruit calendar
calendar.intro: When each fruit on Lisbon's public trees ripens. Seasons are estimates: every tree and every year is different.

sheet.etiquette: Pick by hand or from the ground: don't climb trees, beat or break branches. Take only what you need and never enter private property.
about.rules: In Lisbon it is forbidden to climb or beat public trees (Municipal Tree Regulation, art. 9). Fruits whose collection is restricted by law, like stone-pine cones, are not shown on the map.
about.title: About Fruta da Rua
about.body: A community map of Lisbon's fruit trees showing what's in season. Seasons are estimates for Lisbon's climate and every tree is different.
about.credit: Data: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa, Dados Abertos (CC0).
